title: Chapter 325 Let'S Go Back
content:
Chapter 325 Let'S Go Back

Time flies, and tens of thousands of years have passed.

It has been more than half of the agreed 300,000 years.

The battle of luck also came into being from the center of the Immortal Realm.

As the first person in the younger generation this year, Lu Xue will naturally participate.

However, this battle of luck is very different from the battle of luck in history.

"What! Fight for luck with aliens?!"

"good."

An Lingyun, the president of Tiandi Academy, glanced at all the people present at Tiandi Academy and nodded majesticly.

"In the near future, the fairy world will suffer a catastrophe and the alien race will descend."

"Winning will bring you no worries in the fairy world; defeat will bring you miserable life."

As soon as these words were spoken, the atmosphere in the whole audience suddenly became extremely depressing.

Lu Xue and others who learned the truth in advance were fine, while the rest were extremely solemn.

"This battle of luck will not simply fight for your own luck, but for the luck of the fairy world."

"Because there will be geniuses from alien races in this battle of luck."

A genius from the alien race!

Some were shocked, some were confused, and some were excited.

Everyone has different expressions, but they will work together.

You can have conflicts on weekdays, but you must never have two minds when dealing with foreign races.

"I will let those alien races regret coming to the fairy world."

Lu Xue spoke coldly, showing off the charm of the top genius in the fairy world.

An Lingyun nodded at Lu Xue with relief, and then said, "Lu Xue, this time, the future of luck in the fairy world will be left to you."

Upon hearing this, Lu Xue nodded and said, "Students will definitely not let down the cultivation of the academy and will not let down the expectations of the fairy world."

At the same time, she was also talking in her heart.

It will not disappoint parents' expectations.

Immediately, under the leadership of Lu Xue, a team of top geniuses and monsters in the fairy world rushed towards the place where the Battle of Luck began.

In the blink of an eye.

A vibrant island suddenly came into view.

At this time, a magnificent statue appeared in everyone's sight.

"Dean, who is this?"

Someone asked at the statue.

Upon hearing this, An Lingyun's expression suddenly became extremely solemn.

Then, under the surprised gaze of everyone, An Lingyun slowly bowed to the statue, and then turned around and looked at everyone.

"This person is a great man who starts a battle of luck with his own strength."

"If there is no battle of luck, I don't know how many influential people will be missing in my fairy world."

"It is because of this that he can stand here for a long time and be respected by people from later generations."

After saying that, An Lingyun signaled to Lu Xue and others, and also bowed to the great person.

Everyone did not hesitate at all and quickly saluted.

Such a person deserves their respect.

Only Lu Xue stood in front, looking a little hesitant.

"Do I want it too?"

Upon hearing this, An Lingyun was slightly stunned, but nodded.

Seeing this, although Lu Xue was a little worried, she still gave a hurried salute.

Although Lu Xue did it casually.

But as Lu Xue raised her head, the statue suddenly reacted.

Buzz —

Suddenly, everyone looked at the statue in horror.

The next moment, under everyone's incredible gaze, the statue slowly shattered.

The statue of countless years has existed, and with Lu Xue's casual gift, he completely ended his life.

This statue obviously cannot withstand Lu Xue's gift.

The cause and effect are too great.

However, this is just a small episode.

Soon the geniuses in the fairy world successfully entered the battle of luck.

Everything depends on them.

In the battle of luck, there is an opportunity to change your destiny, and at the same time, you will accidentally die.

What's more, there are geniuses from other races this time, and the danger level has been greatly increased.

At the same time, outside the fairy world.

In the vast galaxy.

The other side of the abyss became more and more active.

Because they found that the two existences seemed to be gone.

......

"Lingyun, do you think this world has an end?"

In a quiet starry sky, Lu Daosheng pulled Yan Lingyun and walked aimlessly forward.

Hearing Lu Daosheng's question, Yan Lingyun shook her head slightly.

"have no idea."

"Then do you think there will be people who are truly invincible?"

At this time, Yan Lingyun stopped and turned to look at Lu Daosheng.

"Aren't you?"

"I?"

Lu Daosheng was a little silent.

He only knew that the system could keep upgrading him.

The system also said that there is no limit to upgrading.

However, he had also been curious about what the source of the system was?

The system said nothing about this.

"Lingyun, if you know there will be unknown dangers ahead, and staying in place is worry-free and spending your life in peace, will you still move forward?"

Looking at Yan Lingyun, Lu Daosheng asked again.

This time, Yan Lingyun's expression became serious.

"Everyone has a different choice, some like comfort, others don't."

"Anyway, I will never stop moving forward. If I know there is danger ahead, then break it."

"What if there is danger behind it?"

"Soon break."

Listening to Yan Lingyun's answer, Lu Daosheng was a little surprised.

Yes, what are you anxious about?

Fear of the unknown dangers of the future?

Fear that the system suddenly disappears one day?

Are you afraid of encountering problems that the system can't deal with?

No, you shouldn't be afraid.

If you stop moving forward because of fear, you will really lose.

People should always look forward and move forward.

Suddenly, Lu Daosheng became open-minded.

Walking has become much lighter.

And at this time.

bite!

A familiar system sounded.

However, the system said nothing.

"system?"

Lu Daosheng called in his heart.

But the system did not respond.

Lu Daosheng looked through the system panel and found that everything was normal, except for the system.

"What's wrong?"

Seeing that Lu Daosheng was a little abnormal, Yan Lingyun asked.

Upon hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and said, "It's okay, let's continue to go."

In this way, Lu Daosheng pulled Yan Lingyun and continued to walk forward.

Where to go.

have no idea.

Anyway, it's right to leave.

Along the way, Lu Daosheng met many creatures of all kinds.

It also allowed Lu Daosheng to learn a lot about what he had never known about.

Until one day, Lu Daosheng finally stopped.

In front of me, there was still a starry sky that could not be seen at first sight.

At this moment, he no longer needs to go on.

Everything seems to have entered a cycle.

What you see seems to be new, but when you think about it carefully, it is actually the same as what you encountered before.

It's just that the appearance is different.

Lu Daosheng wanted to find a truly different place, such as a place that even he could not fully understand.

But if you keep walking, Lu Daosheng obviously can't find it.

It's time for him to change direction.

"Lingyun, let's go back."

"good."

Immediately, the two of them turned around and walked the place they passed.
